contenidos.guion:
Goal: Build an emotional connection through TRINA’s family heritage and authentic origin story.

HOOK — Founder on camera
Some recipes travel much further than the place they came from.

DEVELOPMENT — Founder + B-roll
TRINA started as a family recipe in the Venezuelan Andes, passed down through generations.
Today, that same recipe is bringing flavor to tables across the United States.
And during the holidays, it reminds us that home isn't always a place. Sometimes, it's a flavor we get to share.

CLOSING — Product + family gathering
From our family to your table.

ON-SCREEN TEXT
From Venezuela, with flavor. 🇻🇪🌶️
TRINA HOT SAUCE

Creative direction: Founder speaking naturally, family photographs (if available), genuine cooking footage and product close-ups. Avoid an overly commercial delivery.
contenidos.copy:
Some flavors carry more than taste. They carry memories, traditions, and a little piece of home. ❤️

What started as a family recipe in Venezuela is now finding its way to tables across the United States.

This holiday season, we're celebrating where we come from and the new memories we're making along the way.

Where are you celebrating the holidays this year? 🇻🇪🌶️

Goal: Make viewers crave TRINA by showing how one simple addition can elevate everyday holiday food.

SHOT 1 — A plate of holiday food
Close-up of a delicious but simple plate of roasted chicken, potatoes, or sliders.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
Your holiday food is missing ONE thing...

SHOT 2 — TRINA enters the frame
A bottle of TRINA appears beside the plate.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
And it's not another side dish. 👀

SHOT 3 — The Drizzle
Extreme macro shot of TRINA being poured over the food.
Focus on the creamy texture and the way the sauce coats the dish.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
THAT'S BETTER. 🌶️

SHOT 4 — Final food shot
A fork picks up a bite, showing the sauce.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
BRING MORE FLAVOR TO THE TABLE.
TRINA HOT SAUCE

Creative direction: Sensory, editorial-style food photography, a strong macro shot of the sauce and natural food textures. No voiceover is necessary; food sounds and music can carry the video.
contenidos.copy:

Because sometimes, the smallest addition makes the biggest difference.
